semantic.justification:
Task AQF9AG maps ScImportExport CSV option and conversion behavior to the existing Calc document and file-dialog path. The source token defaults, delimiter weighting, represented charset conversion, quoted/multiline field scanning, ordered column metadata, pass-start nLastCol trailing-empty condition (captured outside the row loop), cell overflow flag and lcl_GetFixed quoted boundary are represented. lcl_PutString now dispatches consumed literal, edit, numeric and formula writes through ScDocumentImport, retaining the source's different newline gates for literal versus standard columns. The source ScDocumentImport::setAutoInput and ScColumn::ParseString chain, formatter-driven special/date classification and the full text filter remain incomplete. The separator path calls a cursor-based ScanNextFieldFromString and advances the original nCol/nSourceCol/bIsLastColEmpty loop directly. Fixed-width fields advance visual offsets and call lcl_GetFixed only for admitted destination columns. ScImportExport::SetExtOptions copies ScAsciiOptions and its column metadata. A lone equals sign remains text and formula-looking multiline fields follow the source edit-cell gate. ReadCsvLine now preserves the source optional separator-detection retry, comma/tab/semicolon precedence over a possible blank separator, caller-owned separator output, preview source-line limit, and unmatched-quote stream rewind. ExtText2Doc continues to call it with detection disabled and no preview limit.
AQF9AG finalizes the importer once after all CSV records. Numeric/string/formula fields now use raw native import writes and deferred formula grouping/listeners. Plain multiline construction still uses the existing document bridge until ScFieldEditEngine is ported and explicitly invalidates cached import positions after external writes.
